name: EEB 5881
title: Internship in Ecology, Conservation, or Evolutionary Biology
description: An internship with a non-profit organization, a governmental agency, or a business under the supervision of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology faculty. Activities relevant to the practice of ecology, biodiversity science, evolutionary biology, or conservation biology will be planned and agreed upon in advance by the job site supervisor, the faculty coordinator, and the intern.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
